executiveSummary: A deadly earthquake in western Colombia caused extensive structural collapse, with at least 111 fatalities, active search and rescue for people trapped, communications outages in Chocó, and flights suspended at multiple airports. View Article Monsoon flooding in India's Assam state has killed 100 people, displaced more than 700,000, and placed nearly 300,000 in relief camps while road and livelihood disruptions continue. View Article Typhoon Dolphin drove mass relocations and transport shutdowns across eastern China, including 1,300+ flight cancellations and rail/ferry suspensions amid severe flood and landslide risk. View Article In the Philippines, monsoon rains intensified by the same system caused at least 19 deaths, affected more than 1 million people, and displaced about 98,000 amid floods and landslides. View Article Fast-moving wildfires around Okanagan Lake, British Columbia forced about 20,000 evacuations, destroyed homes, caused power outages, and led to a provincial emergency; at least one death reported. View Article In and around Spokane, Washington, wildfires destroyed roughly 850 buildings and triggered evacuations of around 67,000 people; displacement and access restrictions persisted. View Article Extreme heat continues to stress European populations and systems: French hospitals reported severe operational strain during earlier heat waves, and millions in Italy remain under top alerts as temperatures stay extreme. Supporting Report View Article At least 230+ fatalities are confirmed across events; reporting varies and numbers are likely to change as assessments continue.

outlook72h: Colombia earthquake: Expect continued aftershocks and intensive SAR; prioritize heavy equipment, specialized USAR teams, emergency shelter, and telecom restoration in worst-hit municipalities. Source China coastal provinces: Continued flood/landslide risk from Typhoon Dolphin's remnants; maintain evacuation readiness, slope monitoring, and transport safety checks. Source Philippines: Localized severe flooding/landslides may persist; prioritize WASH, shelter kits, and debris clearance in affected Luzon communities. Source Wildfires (BC/WA): Hot, dry, and windy conditions could support renewed spread; maintain evacuation readiness, protect critical lines and substations, and surge shelter capacity. Assam, India: Flood waters and disease risk may persist; prioritize safe water access, vector control, and relief camp management. Source Europe/Western US heat: Continue heat-health advisories, cooling center operations, and surge capacity for emergency departments. Source Source Fuego Volcano (Guatemala): Monitor lahar risk during rainfall, maintain exclusion zones, and ensure clear public messaging. Source
regionalTrends: Compound extremes: Heat is amplifying wildfire behavior in North America and Southern Europe, while monsoon and cyclone interactions are driving floods and landslides in South/East Asia. View Article
